summary: Sup3rS3cretMes5age is a lightweight pastebin service written in Go that allows you to share sensitive text via self-destructing links. It relies externally on Hashicorp Vault to securely store the underlying payload until it is retrieved. The application interface is kept minimal for straightforward deployment and usage.
goodFor: It is a practical choice if your infrastructure already runs Hashicorp Vault and you need a dedicated, straightforward tool for transmitting one-off credentials.
watchOut: You must maintain a working Hashicorp Vault instance to store secrets, which introduces a heavy operational dependency for such a simple service. Development activity has also begun to slow down.
deployNotes: Because the application is compiled in Go, it typically runs as a single static binary behind a reverse proxy for TLS termination. You will need to ensure proper network connectivity between the container or binary and your existing Vault deployment.
